**Observation Log:**

- [FACT] User recently visited multiple theme parks including Disneyland, Knott's Berry Farm, Six Flags Magic Mountain, and Universal Studios Hollywood.
- [PREFERENCE] User is looking for recommendations on upcoming theme park events, specifically interested in thrill rides, unique food experiences, and nighttime shows.
- [EVENT] User is particularly interested in Halloween-themed events at theme parks.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Disneyland's Halloween Time starts in mid-September, featuring festive decorations, themed food, and special entertainment, including a Halloween-themed parade and 'Oogie Boogie Bash.'
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Knott's Berry Farm hosts 'Knott's Scary Farm' during the fall, featuring haunted mazes, scare zones, and live entertainment.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Six Flags Magic Mountain's 'Fright Fest' runs from late September to early November, including haunted mazes and themed rides.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Universal Studios Hollywood's 'Halloween Horror Nights' runs from mid-September to early November, featuring haunted houses and scare zones.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Disneyland's must-try Halloween-themed food items include Pumpkin Beignets, Mummy Dogs, Bat Wing Chicken Tenders, and Candy Corn Funnel Cake.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Knott's Berry Farm's must-try Halloween-themed food items include Graveyard Dirt Cups, Mummy Meatball Subs, Skeleton Fingers Cookies, and Blood-Red Punch.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Six Flags Magic Mountain's must-try Halloween-themed food items include Zombie Brain Cupcakes, Mummy Dogs, Skeleton Keys Lime Bars, and Witch's Brew.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Universal Studios Hollywood's must-try Halloween-themed food items include Flesh-Eating Zombie Fingers, Graveyard Cake Pops, Mummy Hot Dogs, and Blood of the Vine.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Unique dining experiences at Disneyland include Blue Bayou Restaurant's Halloween Menu and Carthay Circle Restaurant's Halloween Feast.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Knott's Berry Farm offers a Boo-fet dining experience and a Halloween menu at The Calico Saloon.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Universal Studios Hollywood has The Terror Tipsy Turvey Lounge and a gourmet buffet as part of the VIP Experience.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Six Flags Magic Mountain features The Fright Fest Feast and a Halloween menu at The Full Throttle Sports Bar.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The VIP Experience's Gourmet Buffet at Halloween Horror Nights costs between $250 to over $400 per person, depending on the night and package.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Perks of the VIP Experience's Gourmet Buffet include a gourmet buffet, priority entry, front-of-line access, exclusive VIP lounge, private tour guide
